description: This ground-level photograph depicts a large, flat, salt-encrusted area, consistent with a saline or salt pan, as defined by CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 4.2.2. A raised, unpaved track or embankment runs along the left side of the frame, serving as a boundary for the salt pan and bordering a strip of dense green vegetation. The surface of the open saline area is light brown and white, showing evident salt deposits. In the background, low hills or mountains are visible under a clear blue sky. The image was captured in June 2011 and is attributed as a "CLMS photo" from "LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) data.
